items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I used to learn some little things from Freddie Jenkins. You know Freddie, used to play with Duke?

ctx.x: Well that's what Lunceford's band used to do years ago.
That's right, throw the horn. Freddie Jenkins used to do it too. Echols would throw his higher than anybody and he used to wear those Russian, you've seen the Russian silk pyjamas?
